senses.gloss: (= h. זָרָה) to scatter, strew; to winnow.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 32:20">Targ. O. Ex. XXXII, 20</cite> <cite ref="D01029"><he>דרא</he></cite> ed. Berl. (some ed. <he>זרא</he>); Y. <cite ref="D01080"><he>דרי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 41:16">Targ. Is. XLI, 16</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 30:24">Ib. XXX, 24</cite>; a. fr.—

Ab. Zar. 44ᵃ what proof is there that vayissaëm (II Sam. V, 21) לישנא דדְרוּיֵי הוא Ar. a. ed. Pes. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 7; ed. זרויי) has the meaning of scattering (to the winds)? Ans. (ref. to Is. XLI, 16) ומתרגמינן תדרינון (Ms. M. תבדר׳, ed. תזרי׳, v. supra) and we translate (tissaëm) ‘shall scatter them’.
